method.input_control: Same explicit control information used by the existing EC S3/S4 runner: evidence_refs, dependencies, unexplained-observation rule, candidate relation, unresolved-state rule, and residual-resolution rule.

ec_control_rule_reference.basis: Existing deterministic run_ec_s3_s4.py decision rules; these rules define the mirror assay and are deterministic for these fixtures.

interpretation.primary: The 135M model did not discriminate branches even when the relevant control rules and structured evidence/dependency information were explicit. It collapsed to one label per decision family.
interpretation.candidate_baseline: Candidate accuracy exactly equals the always-YES baseline (12/22 = 0.54545), so observed candidate discrimination above that baseline is zero.
interpretation.scope_limit: This is evidence about this 135M model, not about all lightweight LLMs. The next model-size step is required before attributing the gap to the LLM architecture rather than insufficient capacity.
